summary: Euroseas Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 24, 2026, reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on July 23, 2026. Shareholders approved two routine proposals: re-election of three Class A directors for three-year terms, and ratification of Deloitte CPAs as independent auditors for fiscal 2026. No special situation is present; the filing is a standard current report of annual meeting outcomes. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event applies. Watch for normal quarterly operating updates and newbuilding deliveries from 2027–2029.
